cases.question: Our Singapore private company was incorporated four months ago and has one director. Can that director also become the company secretary, or may we leave the secretary position empty until the first annual return?
expected: The sole director cannot also be the company secretary.
Appoint a secretary within six months of registration; an annual return does not extend this deadline.
forbidden: The sole director may fill both positions.
The appointment deadline runs from the first annual return.

cases.question: Our group has a Singapore-incorporated subsidiary and a foreign company registered in Singapore. Both changed their entity email addresses twelve days ago. Do they have the same ACRA notification deadline, and can either wait until its annual return?
expected: Ordinarily fourteen days for the Singapore company and thirty days for the foreign company, each from its change.
An annual return is not a substitute for timely information updates.
forbidden: Both entities have the same deadline.
Either entity may defer the update until its annual return.

cases.question: For our company's current ECI filing, annual revenue is S$4.8 million and the accounts show a loss. We have not completed the tax adjustments. Is that enough to claim the filing waiver, or what still needs checking?
expected: Both revenue at most S$5 million and nil ECI are required.
An accounting loss does not establish nil ECI; confirm tax adjustments before partial/start-up exemption and relevant FY/YA.
Ordinarily file within three months of FYE if no waiver/exemption established.
forbidden: Low revenue alone or an accounting loss alone establishes the waiver.
Inventing the missing tax computation.

cases.question: Our GST-registered business paid for voluntary staff medical check-ups and repairs to a commercial delivery van. Neither the check-ups nor their provider was required by law, a collective agreement or a government advisory. We hold valid tax invoices. Does the business purpose make GST on both expenses recoverable?
expected: Staff medical input tax is generally blocked; business purpose and an invoice alone do not overcome the restriction.
Assess the stated medical exceptions without inventing them.
A van outside the statutory motor-car definition is not automatically blocked; ordinary input-tax conditions still apply.
forbidden: All business expenses are automatically claimable.
All motor vehicles are blocked motor cars.

cases.question: We discovered an ordinary CPF overpayment last week, but cannot yet locate the payment record. May we use the discovery date to set our refund deadline, and can we wait for CPF Board to refund us before returning the employee's share?
expected: Apply immediately and no later than one year from contribution payment; locate PAYMENTS RECEIVED ON.
Discovery does not restart the period; no calendar deadline without payment date.
Return employee share directly before applying, where applicable.
forbidden: A year runs from discovery.
Inventing a calendar deadline.
Waiting for CPF Board's refund before returning employee share.

cases.question: Our employee must repay a conditional bonus after failing its service condition. CPF was paid eighteen months ago, but the employment agreement does not state a repayment date and we have not agreed one with the employee. Is a CPF refund necessarily out of time?
expected: Conditional-wage timing differs from ordinary payment-based timing.
Establish when those wages became due for repayment under employment terms or mutual agreement.
Facts do not establish a precise deadline or definite time bar.
forbidden: Necessarily barred because CPF was paid eighteen months ago.
Inventing repayment date from resignation/discovery/application.
Guaranteeing acceptance.

cases.question: An employee covered by the Employment Act has completed four months of service, supplied the required medical certificate and informed us within twenty-four hours. Is the statutory entitlement already fourteen outpatient sick-leave days plus sixty hospitalisation days?
expected: At four completed months: eight outpatient and thirty hospitalisation days.
Full fourteen/sixty schedule starts at six months; hospitalisation limit includes outpatient leave.
Remaining entitlement depends on leave used and qualifying certification.
forbidden: Four months establishes the full fourteen/sixty entitlement.
The allowances are wholly additive.

cases.question: Our Employment Act-covered employee is still on probation after five completed months. Their contract provides fourteen annual-leave days a year, and they took approved unpaid leave. Can we deny annual leave until confirmation, and can you determine the exact balance without knowing the unpaid-leave period or leave already used?
expected: Eligibility after at least three months includes probation.
Pro-rate by completed service months using applicable annual entitlement, excluding approved unpaid-leave periods.
Missing unpaid-leave/used-leave facts prevent exact remaining balance.
forbidden: Probation removes eligibility.
Inventing an exact balance.

cases.question: At our LFMC, an existing director's residential address changes and the CEO resigns during the same week. Do both notifications have the same fourteen-day outer limit, and is changing the director's particulars treated as a fresh Form 11 appointment approval?
expected: Distinguish row17 subsequent notifications from row3 appointment approval.
Both categories: as soon as practicable; additional fourteen-day outer limit specifically for resignation.
Particulars update alone is not fresh appointment approval.
forbidden: Every row17 notification has a fourteen-day outer limit.
An address update automatically requires fresh appointment approval.

cases.question: Our venture capital fund manager has not confirmed its financial year-end. Can we use the calendar-year nil-misconduct return deadline for Form 25A and assume that filing Form 25A also completes every reporting obligation of the funds we manage?
expected: Form25A due within one month of manager FYE; specific date requires FYE.
Conditional nil-misconduct return has separate calendar-year basis and fourteen-day period.
Manager declaration does not establish every fund-level obligation.
forbidden: Form25A uses nil-misconduct deadline.
Inventing FYE or calendar deadline.
Manager declaration is complete fund-level checklist.
